scope: Fresh owned parametric documents only. Independent XY target Patch and XZ sheet face/body tool or XY SketchLine. Exact tool argument, normalized input/rolled feature tool, all temporary cells and current results remain distinct. Cell indices label API enumeration only; selection is an explicit observed geometric request, not persistent/native identity.

requested_setup.selection: Clear every cell; remove only the unique target-plane cell with bounding-box center y>0. All other valid cells remain unselected.

transaction_policy: Every returned TrimFeatureInput is added or cancelled in finally before timeline/export/close. A failed cancellation halts the batch and leaves the owned document untouched for diagnosis.

entrypoint_provenance.invocation: Absolute runpy of GenerateSurfaceTrimToolContrasts.py; explicitly selected owned cases

lifecycle_policy: Capture frame releases Trim wrappers while timeline is before the feature and document is open; outer garbage collection, short final compute/export frame, second garbage collection, then document close. Unsafe transaction/lifecycle state is quarantined on adsk.fusion and halts without export/close/new case.
